property_goal: Show that the submitted RTL allows force_masks_i to drive the Bivium lockup override even when SecAllowForcingMasks is disabled.

expected_formal_outcome.assertions: FAIL on the submitted RTL when SecAllowForcingMasks=0 and force_masks_i=1 is reachable.
expected_formal_outcome.violation_cover: COVERED in the same sampled cycle because bivium_allow_lockup follows force_masks_i.

properties.name: CSBC_CALIPTRA_AES_BUG006_FORCE_MASKS_DISABLED_BLOCKS_LOCKUP
properties.intent: When force-mask support is disabled, a high force_masks_i input must not assert the Bivium lockup override.
properties.temporal_reasoning: force_masks_i and bivium_allow_lockup are combinationally related in aes_prng_masking, so a same-cycle implication is sufficient.

properties.name: CSBC_CALIPTRA_AES_BUG006_DISABLED_LOCKUP_INVARIANT
properties.intent: When force-mask support is disabled, the Bivium lockup override should remain low for every input valuation.
properties.temporal_reasoning: The feature gate is a static parameter and the checked signal is combinational in the target RTL.

properties.name: CSBC_CALIPTRA_AES_BUG006_TRIGGER
properties.intent: Cover the reachable trigger: SecAllowForcingMasks is disabled and force_masks_i is high.
properties.temporal_reasoning: The trigger is sampled in one active clock cycle after reset.

properties.name: CSBC_CALIPTRA_AES_BUG006_VIOLATION
properties.intent: Cover the trigger while the Bivium lockup override is high.
properties.temporal_reasoning: The implemented violation is same-cycle because bivium_allow_lockup is assigned directly from force_masks_i.

source_evidence.reason: Declares SecAllowForcingMasks, the static feature gate for force_masks_i.
Treats force_masks_i as unused when SecAllowForcingMasks is 0.
Forwards bivium_allow_lockup to the Bivium primitive allow_lockup_i port.

assumption_review.justification: No environmental assumptions are needed. force_masks_i is an unconstrained input and the failing path is combinational before any primitive state matters.

limitations: The proof observes the wrapper signal bivium_allow_lockup, which is the signal driving the primitive input. It does not model primitive state.
The proof establishes that the override input is assertable while the feature gate is disabled. It does not by itself establish a downstream state change; see the containment note in README.md.

actual_formal_outcome.vacuity: the :noDeadEnd and :noConflict properties were proven, and no assumptions were used
actual_formal_outcome.elaboration: aes_prng_masking elaborated as top with 41 analyzed Verilog modules and no blackbox
